scientific_integrity: An elementary analytic proof for all positive heights is supplied. Finite program checks corroborate but cannot certify infinite statements. Historical priority provisional; two relevant older stereological full texts unavailable.
scientific_limitations: Only Haar-uniform central sections of regular right pentagonal prisms; not affine random-offset cuts or irregular bases. No uniqueness of the heptagon-probability maximum is claimed.
title: The complete Haar central-section polygon law of a regular pentagonal prism
